Audio transcription with explicit language hint

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"file\":\"audio_de.mp3\",\"language\":\"de\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\"}", CreateTranscriptionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.transcribe(req)
    println(result.text)
}
```
